method: sqlite3 URI mode=ro&immutable=0, GROUP BY (model, provider, cost_status)

kanban_7d.note: done counted by completed_at >= now-7d; blocked counted by created_at >= now-7d (list API has no updated_at); blocked_currently is current count regardless of when created

limitations: insights --days 7 aggregates only the calling profile (operations); per_profile table above is the canonical fleet-wide baseline.
reasoning_tokens may already be included in output_tokens on some providers; do NOT sum them.

cost_status=included / 0 USD = subscription quota, NOT free. Paid rails identified by provider+billing_mode pairs: openrouter, custom (chat_completions), zai (chat_completions), kilocode, moa, groq, cloudflare, ollama-cloud, alibaba, copilot, opencode-zen, opencode-free, mistral.
kanban_7d blocked uses created_at (list API lacks updated_at); blocked_currently is current snapshot count.
insights cost section: only 1 session included (subscription), 114 unknown (no pricing data).

live drift after captured_at: fleet keeps writing to state.db; post-audit recount of the same profile will show higher counters (this kanban task itself added ~250k input tokens to operations between snapshot and audit). To reconcile, filter WHERE first_seen < captured_at.
